historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly refuses unattended execution, but it does not prove the source raw payload or provide an exact per-parameter rollback.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly converts the open write into a one-parameter approved transaction and treats missing material as prerequisites, not automatic BLOCKED.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run location was found but excluded as authority; the DCMI capability records were checked and remain read-only/non-authorizing.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Network configuration writes require exact bytes, observable semantics and an independent access path before execution.

original_test_intent: Change one approved DCMI DHCP/discovery configuration parameter through the local in-band path, verify the resulting value and relevant behavior, and restore the baseline when required.
original_method: Preserve raw 0x2c 0x12 0xdc and the five selector definitions, but select exactly one parameter, derive its revision/data bytes from the approved specification, capture its getter baseline, write once and perform semantic read-back.
manual_activity: The network/BMC owner selects and approves one exact parameter/value, validates its DCMI Table 6-6 encoding and expected effect, and provides a maintenance window, alternate access and verified baseline restore path.
required_inputs: Verified DUT/BMC and local IPMI route
Approved DCMI specification revision and matching package
Exactly one selector and revision/data byte sequence
Decoded baseline from the corresponding get operation
safety_requirements: Never choose a default selector or value
Validate reserved bits, range and payload length
Maintain independent access for DHCP/discovery changes
Stop on ambiguous completion or read-back
Restore only under the approved plan
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and approved specification profile
Read and decode the selected parameter baseline
Present exact write and restore bytes for approval
Issue one approved local raw write
Re-read exact selector and observe intended network behavior
Archive all raw, semantic and reachability evidence
engineer_actions: Approve the selector, exact value, expected effect and recovery
Ensure the test is isolated from production management
Own final PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The generic `DCMI_PARAM` CLI form neither preserves the Master raw request nor identifies exact bytes, and its SSH transport is not the named local in-band execution path.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Read the chosen selector baseline with the approved getter; after explicit approval, issue one local raw 0x2c 0x12 0xdc <selector> 0 <validated-data>, then re-read that selector and verify its network semantics before any planned restore.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All five selector meanings, revision byte position, in-band route and 10/5 timing are retained; no configuration bytes are guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each selector as its own typed transaction with a specification-derived encoder/decoder, baseline token, exact approval, alternate-path monitor and idempotence-free rollback workflow.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds value authorization, getter pairing, network-effect oracle and recovery while leaving the Master placeholders intact.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command completion or getter output alone cannot prove that DHCP activation, discovery policy or timing behavior changed as intended.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incorrect DHCP/discovery value can move the BMC address, disrupt discovery or delay lease behavior; the local host path may survive while remote manageability is lost.

project_override_considerations: A vendor CLI may replace the raw setter only with documented byte-for-byte semantics and equivalent read-back/effect evidence; if raw coverage is omitted, that difference must be recorded.
expected_evidence: Baseline raw getter response and decoded state
Exact approved set request/response and completion
DHCP/discovery/timing behavior observed against a named oracle
Restored baseline and reachability when required

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master consistently identifies a DCMI configuration setter, its selectors and the external table governing variable data. Placeholders, success-only acceptance and log clearing are incomplete or unsafe, but they do not contradict the named operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and selector family are identifiable. Exact bytes, desired value, baseline and recovery are obtainable execution prerequisites, so the case remains REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.

review_improvement: Narrows an open-ended network setter to one specification-encoded, approved and reversible transaction with both byte-level and behavioral verification.
independent_technical_reasoning: The five selectors do not share one generic value domain: activation flags, discovery settings and timing fields have different lengths and effects. A safe agent must bind one selector to its exact schema, preserve the old state, keep access independent of the setting being changed, and test the resulting behavior rather than treating a zero completion code as success.
